title: ChannelGuard: From Borrowed Safety to Application-Controlled Defenses in Multi-Agent LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2607.19430v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: AI assistants increasingly work as teams, where one model makes a plan, others search the web, use tools, or read stored information, and another writes the final answer. This creates new security risks because harmful instructions can enter through information passed between models, not just through the user's message. Yet safety tests usually report only whether an attack succeeded, without showing what actually stopped it. We show that systems with similar safety scores can depend on very different protections. Across five agent models, attacks were stopped by a cloud provider's filter, by the model itself, or by inconsistent model behavior. This matters because protection that comes from the model or provider may disappear when either one changes. We introduce CHANNELGUARD, an application-controlled defense that checks information at each handoff without extra training or additional model calls. Across more than 5,700 test

translated_title: ChannelGuard：多智能体大语言模型中从“借来的安全”到应用可控防御
translated_abstract: AI 助手越来越多地以团队形式协作：一个模型制定计划，其他模型搜索网络、使用工具或读取存储的信息，再由另一个模型撰写最终答案。这带来了新的安全风险，因为有害指令不仅可以通过用户的消息进入，还可以通过模型之间传递的信息进入。然而，安全测试通常只报告攻击是否成功，而不揭示究竟是什么阻止了攻击。我们表明，安全评分相近的系统可能依赖截然不同的防护机制。在五个智能体模型中，攻击分别被云提供商的过滤器、模型自身，或模型不一致的行为所阻止。这一点至关重要，因为来自模型或提供商的防护可能在任一方发生变化时随之消失。我们提出 CHANNELGUARD，这是一种应用可控的防御机制，在每次信息交接时进行检查，无需额外训练或额外的模型调用。在超过 5,700 次测试中……
tldr: 提出ChannelGuard，一种应用层可控的多智能体LLM防御机制，在模型间每次信息交接处检查有害指令，无需额外训练或模型调用，使安全防护从依赖模型或提供商的“借来保护”转变为由应用自身掌控。
en_tdlr: ChannelGuard is an application-controlled defense that inspects information at each handoff in multi-agent LLM systems without extra training or model calls, shifting safety from borrowed model/provider protections to defenses fully controlled by the application.
